summary: Carrying a clip onto a track that will not take it now says the real reason under the hand: Audio takes sound only, V2 is locked, or no room on V2 only when something is actually in the way.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Open a screen recording and drop a second clip after it on V1.

try.do: Drag a picture clip down onto the Audio track and hold it there: the words under the hand read Audio takes sound only.
Lock V2 with its padlock, then drag a clip up onto V2 clear of anything on it: the words read V2 is locked.
Unlock V2 and drag a clip up onto V2 where another clip already sits at that time: the words read no room on V2.
Pick two clips with Command click and drag them down onto Audio together: it reads Audio takes sound only too.
Let go in each case: the clip only slides in time and stays on its own track.

evaluate: Does each reason tell you what to do next without hunting for a clip that is not there?
Is takes sound only (or picture only) the wording you would expect, or would you rather see something like Audio track: sound only?
With several clips picked, when another picked clip is the one refused, is it clear enough that the named track is that clip's, not the one under your hand?
rough: No mock draws a refused drop, so there is nothing to put beside it; the words sit in the existing capsule after the move readout, as no room did before.
The capsule rides on the clip's own bar on its own track while the target lane lights red, so the words are a lane away from the track they name. That was already so before this change.
A track with a long name (a graphic's track is named after the graphic) can push the words past 30 characters, as no room on <name> could before.
